source.prefixDecision: The local regex also stripped chat:/typing:/activity:/pins:. No library service (chat subscribes and fans out on the bare name; typing is a chat action; activity:broadcast is the library firehose), no portal hook and no host producer names a channel with those prefixes (dist + source grep). baseChannel leaves them on, so their partition is never a tenant and admitName refuses: fail closed. Only chat: around a DM lobby is unwrapped (chat:social:dm:a:b admitted for members). Two guard tests that asserted chat:social:ch:general and one that asserted typing: publish were updated to false.
source.notMoved: The DM/channel unread producers stay router plugins. Router plugin onMessage receives no scope in 0.107, so their isClientSubscribed probes stay fresh; liveSubscribersForUsers accepts and forwards a scope for callers that have one (chat message hooks). Remote probes are answered by the peer under its own check either way.

fenceArgument: Lifetime: the shared entry lives in the library scope memo only; share is consulted only while scope.active, and the observer is disposed on scope close. A closed scope is never used (fresh read, as before 0.107). No positive answer outlives the operation.
Order: directory -> policy -> membership (shared) -> directory per check, as before; no proof starts before the directory (the reverted fanout-proof failure mode).

Revocation: the shared read registers its change observer synchronously before its durable read starts and keeps it until close; each check additionally holds its own observer from its start. A committed local write or peer social:membership hint flips the shared flag, which is sticky, so every remaining check of that operation on that channel denies. listMembers callers get a fresh read instead (rows are data; the chat service failing open on a thrown read is avoided).
Directory, actor and policy: never shared; asked per check (epoch bump, actor retirement, grant/policy revocation deny mid-operation).
Failure: a rejected shared read is dropped by the scope; that check denies, the next retries.
